info.title: BOB API
info.description: Customer memory and proactive insights. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`; the workspace is derived from the key. Errors use `{ error: { code, message, request_id, details? } }`. Canonical contract: docs/api.md.

apiKey.description: Workspace API key issued by the operator CLI; shown once at creation.

post.summary: Accept a source event (JSON envelope or text/plain note) and queue the Librarian
post.description: Commits the original source, a customer source revision, a Librarian job and its outbox row atomically. Acceptance is not proof of a brain update. Never triggers the Proactor.

post.summary: Ask a question grounded in the current brain (asynchronous)
post.description: Queues a read-only query job against the latest brain. With `wait_seconds` the request is held until the job is terminal (`200` with the job) or the wait ends (`202`). Counts against the model admission group. Never changes the brain.
